Dabang Delhi TTC Secures Second Consecutive Victory in UTT

Dabang Delhi TTC has achieved their second consecutive win in the Ultimate Table Tennis (UTT) league. They secured a comeback victory against the UP Prometheans in their opening match of the season. This marks a strong start for the team in the ongoing tournament.
